old_caption: The video captures a serene winter scene centered around a fire pit. The fire pit is circular and constructed from metal, featuring a mesh grate on top to contain the flames. Inside the pit, a small fire burns brightly, with orange and yellow flames dancing over the logs and embers. The logs are partially consumed by the fire, emitting smoke that rises into the air. The surrounding ground is covered with a mix of snow and patches of exposed earth, indicating recent snowfall or melting conditions. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing closely on the fire pit and its immediate surroundings. The overall atmosphere is calm and peaceful, with the gentle crackling of the fire providing a soothing soundtrack to the visual tranquility. There are no visible characters or animals in the frame, emphasizing the solitude and quiet beauty of the winter landscape.

caption: The video captures an outdoor round metal fire barrel set on snow-dusted gravel, viewed from a high angle. The left half of the opening holds a pile of thin sticks and split wood already burning with orange-yellow flames, while the right half is covered by a perforated metal grate carrying a small silver pot. A bent metal handle spans the middle, separating the burning side from the grated side. The flames continuously flicker, rise, and lean, their tongues shifting position and brightness over the wood pile. Glowing embers and reddish wood surfaces brighten and dim as the fire consumes the kindling. Thin wisps of pale smoke drift near the center and right of the opening. The wood pile, grate, pot, and barrel rim remain in place, and the snow-and-gravel background appears steady. The fire continues burning throughout.
